review.why: Adds, fixes and validates JSON-LD schema markup, and first checks whether Google still supports the rich result wanted; FAQ and HowTo are retired.
review.summary: Lists common types with required properties, gives JSON-LD and graph patterns, and notes that valid Schema.org markup does not make a page eligible for a Google feature. It names retired features (FAQ rich results, HowTo, sitelinks search box), then covers validation tools, common errors and an implementation checklist.
strengths: Separates Schema.org validity from Google feature eligibility
Warns against adding markup just to get a retired appearance
Checklist ties markup to visible page content
cautions: Google's supported-feature list changes, so dates in it will age
Full JSON-LD examples are in a file not read here
Does not edit a site itself
